### Marcus Corporation Declares Quarterly Dividend


November 4, 2026


MILWAUKEE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Directors of[The Marcus Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcuscorp.com&esheet=54635174&newsitemid=20261104263538&lan=en-US&anchor=The+Marcus+Corporation&index=1&md5=96d78dd855e516f89bc7b36326c94e6b) (NYSE: MCS) today declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.09 per share of common stock. The dividend will be paid December 15, 2026, to shareholders of record on November 25, 2026.


The Board of Directors also declared a dividend of $0.082 per share on the Class B common stock. The dividend on the Class B common stock, which is not publicly traded, will also be paid December 15, 2026, to shareholders of record on November 25, 2026.


**About Marcus Corporation**


Headquartered in Milwaukee,[Marcus Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.com%2Fv3%2F__http%3A%2Fwww.marcuscorp.com%2F__%3B%21%21L2Ps738%21jBacXqKXVta1UtnNf1PzgYg3Tt_HD3_f7UaOboef_7qdBRa_Iy4YUslUBHV1TSww%24&esheet=54635174&newsitemid=20261104263538&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Corporation&index=2&md5=ddf7fd28970f19743f0c653d62238939) is a leader in the entertainment and hospitality industries, with significant company-owned real estate assets. Marcus Corporation’s theatre division,[Marcus Theatres®](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.com%2Fv3%2F__http%3A%2Fwww.marcustheatres.com%2F__%3B%21%21L2Ps738%21jBacXqKXVta1UtnNf1PzgYg3Tt_HD3_f7UaOboef_7qdBRa_Iy4YUslUBFgbSFlY%24&esheet=54635174&newsitemid=20261104263538&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Theatres%26%23174%3B&index=3&md5=dd96ef53a7f394076fce5897d4843427) , is the fourth largest theatre circuit in the U.S. and currently owns or operates 975 screens at 77 locations in 17 states under the Marcus Theatres, Movie Tavern® by Marcus and Bistro *Plex* ® brands. The company’s hospitality division,[Marcus® Hotels & Resorts](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.com%2Fv3%2F__http%3A%2Fwww.marcushotels.com%2F__%3B%21%21L2Ps738%21jBacXqKXVta1UtnNf1PzgYg3Tt_HD3_f7UaOboef_7qdBRa_Iy4YUslUBBkXLtbb%24&esheet=54635174&newsitemid=20261104263538&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus%26%23174%3B+Hotels+%26amp%3B+Resorts&index=4&md5=1b8317d50855dd31b2dc334556a65c42) , owns and/or manages 18 hotels, resorts and other properties in eight states. For more information, please visit the company’s website at[www.marcuscorp.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.com%2Fv3%2F__http%3A%2Fwww.marcuscorp.com%2F__%3B%21%21L2Ps738%21jBacXqKXVta1UtnNf1PzgYg3Tt_HD3_f7UaOboef_7qdBRa_Iy4YUslUBHV1TSww%24&esheet=54635174&newsitemid=20261104263538&lan=en-US&anchor=www.marcuscorp.com&index=5&md5=3304541c8f60da8a582ad9b09eb96c04) .
